assumptions.coverage: every undirected decision-to-decision segment in the largest reachable component
assumptions.choice: uniform among all incident segments, including the segment just used
assumptions.start: uniform among junctions with at least three incident segments
assumptions.water: ferries, non-highway links, and every bridge-tagged way excluded; HPI zero
assumptions.ranking: lowest completion rate first, then descending median traversal distance divided by unique network length
